name: Apcotex Industries Limited
summary: Apcotex Industries Limited manufactures and sells specialty emulsion polymers in India and internationally. The company offers synthetic rubber products, including nitrile butadiene rubber (NBR), NBR-PVC polyblends, high styrene rubber (HSR), and powdered nitrile butadiene rubber (PNBR); synthetic latexes, such as styrene-butadiene latex, nitrile latex, vinyl pyridine latex, pure acrylic and styrene acrylic latex, specialty NBR latex, XSB latex, and XNB latex; and B2C products under the ApcoBuild brand.
